## Why

Sourcewell and OMNIA Partners publish the cooperative master-award
records of record — the public contract pages a jurisdiction's
piggyback purchase rides on (the discovery's Sourcewell 101223-AXN
Axon award and OMNIA supplier/contract-documents listings). The pages
are *public unauthenticated*, but served bytes routinely carry staff
contact names, descriptions and contact fields that are
Part VIII-protected — so the connector's deliverable is a **screened,
redacted rendition** plus the upstream URL and the original's digest,
never the raw page. Where no reliable redaction exists the row is a
recorded refusal, not a stored raw (the ticket's verbatim rule). Both
platforms' terms affirmatively prohibit automated extraction —
captured verbatim per page family (SIG-LIC-004a); decision-catalog
I7-C3 [B-39] authorised leg A's bounded screen GETs under ADR-184's
envelope, so the source rows stay gated: leg B (the first real wire
as a connector run) is the operator's OP-26 act — staged, never
performed.

## What ships

- **`connectors/cooperative.py`** — the `cooperative` connector
  (eight-stage). `discover()` walks exactly the committed
  `data/cooperative_targets.toml` inventory (a binding outside it
  refuses loud). `fetch()` = one polite GET per target through
  `ctx.fetcher` only (host opt-out → target opt-out → politeness →
  interstitial check → kind dispatch → in-memory Part VIII screen →
  admit), each outcome recorded on the connector's per-target ledger.
  Five bounded kinds: `contract_page` (the Sourcewell master-contract
  page — contract id + linked-document COUNT + meta), `supplier_page`
  (the OMNIA public supplier listing — `page_index`, no contract
  minted), `contract_documents_page` (the OMNIA public
  contract-documents INDEX — `documents_member_gated` recorded;
  documents are pointers, never submitted/fetched), `sw_terms_page` /
  `om_terms_page` (both platforms' terms — verbatim bounded captures).
  `capture()` persists ONLY the screened records: a `FetchResult` that
  never passed the screen is refused; the served page's own bytes are
  never stored.
- **The rendition machinery** — `_build_rendition` walks the
  allowlisted fields, screens each candidate under its declared
  hazard name (`screen_as` — contact_name/author→`name`,
  description/notes→`description`/`notes`), redacts a hit in memory
  (name + classes + value sha256 into `redacted_fields`, names-only
  `refused_fields`), then screens the whole canonical record again:
  residual hits → `sig.cooperative-refusal/1` (pointer + counts +
  hash — the content itself is dropped); clean →
  `sig.cooperative-rendition/1` (allowlisted fields + redaction
  provenance + contract-page URL + original sha256 + byte size +
  linked-document count).
- **Committed data** — `data/cooperative_targets.toml`
  (`sig.cooperative-targets/1`: 5 seeds — the Sourcewell
  `101223-axn` contract page + `terms-use`, the OMNIA `flock-safety`
  supplier page + `gaggle` contract-documents index + `terms-of-use`;
  each row is URL + kind + source + evidence ref, never content;
  fail-closed on drift — schema/count/sort/https/public-path) +
  `data/cooperative_vocab.toml` (`sig.cooperative-vocab/1`: the
  predicate allowlist + forbidden genres (party/piggyback/deployment),
  the five kinds' reviewed public path patterns + the member-gated
  flag, the committed host sets, terms element ids, interstitial
  markers, document-link suffixes, the `screen_as` hazard-name map).
- **Registry wiring** — `sources.toml`: both pre-existing rows
  amended (notes record the verbatim captured-terms prohibitions +
  the I7-C3 [B-39] basis; `access_method` names the connector path;
  `.rights` blocks appended UNDETERMINED/`redistributable=false` +
  `derivative_permitted=false`; custody → `DERIVE` on both
  (`omnia_partners` LINK→DERIVE, `sourcewell` REFERENCE→DERIVE —
  recorded deviations); both redistribution rows → `P8-2`
  (released records — the pages carry screened contact detail) +
  `lane = "unknown"` + `review_needed` with the stale `custody`
  evidence strings corrected) — **both stay
  `ingestion_permitted=false`**;
  `live_targets.toml` + `live_targets.py` expand the
  `cooperative_targets` kind per source; `runner.py`
  `CONNECTOR_FOR_SOURCE` maps both ids + the fixture-run
  target-resolution set; `live_dispositions.toml` rows removed (the
  sources are connector-mapped now); `__init__.py` registers the
  module.
- **Screen membership** — `ops/at_rest_audit.toml`: `sourcewell*` +
  `omnia_partners*` appended to I7-S6 (free text) and I7-S7
  (incidental person names — the staff-contact hazard); the connector
  consumes the SAME committed declaration through `evidence.screen` —
  no drifted copy.
- **Claims** — allowlisted to exactly the committed predicates
  (`contract`, `contract_number`, `external_id`, `document`,
  `platform`, `acquisition_method`, `title` + the artifact row's
  `released_documents`), every claim carrying `contract_page` (the
  cooperative's public page); index records are
  `contract_index`/`page_index`, captures are `evidence_artifact`
  rows with integrity `screened_rendition`, plus `terms_capture`,
  `capture_refusal` and per-capture `quality_report` rows. A denied
  field name in emitted facts fails loud (`PredicateNotAllowed`
  family) — never a warning. Forbidden genres guard the lane's
  bound: no buyer/seller, no `parent_cooperative_contract`, no
  deployment claims — the piggyback linkage is the procurement
  lane's own record.
- **Tests** — `tests/connectors/test_cooperative.py` (27) + committed
  fixtures under `tests/connectors/fixtures/cooperative/` (7). Zero
  network — a `FakeTransport` serves canned pages through a real
  `PoliteFetcher`.
- **Leg-A queue + leg-B packet** —
  `docs/build/reports/rights/p3678/leg-a-queue.toml` (5 legs, all
  `queued`/`prepared_not_executed`, blocker recorded) +
  `leg-b-packet.md` (the operator's first-wire act staged —
  agent-drafted, go lines blank).

## Deviations / deferrals

1. **The ticket's `I7-C14` label names no catalog record** — the
   discovery evidence the ticket cites is `decision_catalog.csv`
   row **I7-C3** (Sourcewell/OMNIA "prohibit robots and
   reproduction" → "fetch despite terms", packet B-39) plus the I6/I7
   candidate rows (I7-U478 / I6-C001 + SRC-010; I7-U440 / I6-C002;
   I7-U441 / I9b-C036). Recorded honestly in the inventory's
   `source_ref` — the seed set cites the verbatim evidence ids,
   never an invented catalog row.
2. **Persisted artifact = the screened record, never the served
   page** (ADR-185's strongest read — same posture as
   P36.74/P36.76/P36.77). The raw page is fetched once, parsed +
   screened in memory, dropped; contract document binaries
   (Sourcewell's PDF/XLSX links, OMNIA's member-gated files) are
   pointer COUNTS only — never fetched; the member form is recorded,
   never submitted.
3. **Custody → `DERIVE` on both rows** — `omnia_partners` was LINK
   (a LINK-posture row can never admit a content-fetching connector
   even after the HG-03 flip — `custody_permits_fetch`);
   `sourcewell` was REFERENCE (admits fetch, but the lane persists
   derived screened renditions only, never a served-byte reference
   copy). DERIVE says what the lane does — the same posture
   `muckrock_public` carries. Both rows stay
   `ingestion_permitted=false` + UNDETERMINED.
4. **Leg A's GETs queued** — `live_verification=false` dispatch +
   the probe-UA precondition fails (`live:P35.38a`:
   `/data-collection/` 404 at 2026-10-27T11:10:24Z, root 200 —
   SIG-INGEST-036 forbids a descriptive UA citing a dead owned
   page). **D-P36.78-1** (kind V, OPEN) carries the 5 legs; the
   OM-19 re-run prompt is recorded verbatim.
5. **Leg B held** — **D-P36.78-2** (kind V, OPEN): the operator's
   OP-26 act; the packet is staged `prepared_not_executed`.
6. **No contract ids invented** — ids the discovery named without a
   recorded public URL (Sourcewell 010720-WCH, 101223-MOT,
   030425-SND; OMNIA R250203) are NOT seeded; other cooperatives
   beyond the ticket's set defer to a future catalog row.
7. **Size budget overage recorded** (~2,560 non-generated/
   non-fixture lines vs the S ≤1,500 band — connector 1,504 +
   tests 718 + data 236 + queue/packet ~210 + wiring ~50) — same
   posture as P36.74/P36.76/P36.77's recorded overages; the
   docstring-heavy policy surface and the refusal-kind records are
   what reviewers audit.
8. **Obligation-tooling note** — `obligation_events.py append`
   deadlocks on a ticket opening two DEFERRALS rows at once (each
   anchor's pre-check is blocked by the other row's missing
   anchor); the anchors were appended exactly as P36.76/P36.77
   recorded — chain `check` verified green.
